evidence.exact_quote: A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children.
Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of the world's deadliest episodes of cult activity.

Before the hearing began on Friday morning, Francis Wanje, who lost eight relatives including two grandchildren in Shakahola forest, told the BBC's Newsday programme that he was "hoping for... a sentence which will match his [Mackenzie's] deeds in the forest".

framing_claims.text: El medio presenta el caso como un juicio histórico que condena al líder sectario a 200 años por un genocidio de niños, resaltando la gravedad y la respuesta judicial.

language_claims.descriptive_alternative: uno de los episodios más mortíferos de actividad sectaria
